segments.text: You have been tasked with performing a new procedure in the laboratory.
segments.zh: 你被安排在实验室里执行一项新的操作程序。

segments.text: You review the current risk assessment form and SOPs available,
segments.zh: 你查看了现有的风险评估表和可用的标准操作规程（SOP），

segments.text: but are concerned that the new procedure may have additional risks.
segments.zh: 但担心这项新程序可能还存在额外的风险。
